## Core Projects
- [AgentTrustLedger](https://github.com/89Aman/AgentTrustLedger): Neutral escrow-and-reputation protocol and verification layer for autonomous agent-to-agent transactions.
- [ContextLens](https://github.com/89Aman/Contextlens): AI-driven developer companion capturing coding intent, tracking development episodes, and generating project telemetry.
- [TalentLens](https://github.com/89Aman/Talentlens): Intelligent candidate evaluation and ranking system replacing keyword filtering with comparative LLM reasoning.
- [Parivesh 3.0](https://github.com/89Aman/Parivesh-3.0): Environmental Clearance workflow engine with React + FastAPI, Supabase PostgreSQL, and AI-generated MoM briefs.
- [Knowledge Vault](https://github.com/89Aman/Knowledge-vault): Production semantic search engine with RAG pipeline. Dense 384-dim embeddings + hybrid scoring.
- [CampusFix](https://github.com/89Aman/CampusFix): Smart campus facility management platform built for GDG Solution Challenge. 500+ QPS FastAPI backend.
